agreed_facts.text: Ukraine accused SpaceX of restricting or limiting its Starlink access, disrupting military and drone operations.
Elon Musk said any limits on Ukraine's access were the responsibility of the US government, military or President Trump, not his company.
Starlink is described as central to Ukraine's battlefield communications.
The restrictions came suddenly or unexpectedly, with one report placing them overnight into Wednesday.
The episode is set against worsening ties or pressure between the Trump administration and Ukraine.
The restrictions coincided with Russian missile attacks on Ukraine.
